description: This file contains functions and logic to generate JUnit XML test reports from shell test scripts, supporting integration with Azure Pipelines and Git's test suite.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes JUnit XML output for a test script, creating necessary directories and opening the XML structure.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Marks the start time for a test case execution.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes the output for a test case, recording success, failure, or skipped status, and appending appropriate XML elements.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Completes the overall test suite XML, adjusting overall timing and closing tags.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Writes XML content to the specified junit XML file, optionally truncating existing content.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes attributes for XML output, handling special characters and encoding.
